characters.description: A dark-haired man in a black jacket and a patterned light shirt.
A woman with tied-back light brown hair, a blue and black jacket and black trousers with pink stripes.
A man with glasses and curly hair wearing a dark jacket.
A long-haired man wearing a light shirt.
A man with a circular mechanical device over one eye.

events.description: White text reads: Blender Foundation Presents.
Rocket engines blaze above a red metal structure.
A rocket rises above a city skyline.
A man and a woman stand beside a canal on a metal bridge.
The woman raises her mechanical right hand toward the man.
White text over a dark industrial interior reads: 40 years later.
Orange and blue wireframe figures stand among machinery and floating colored lines.
A hand turns a knob on a control panel beneath colored digital displays.
Several people stand around machinery behind translucent colored displays.
A brain sits exposed on a round illuminated platform, surrounded by fine wires and needles.
A man peers over the brain with a circular mechanical device over one eye.
White text reads: Tears of Steel.
Smoke hangs over a dark city as a large platform hovers beside a tower.
